title: Understanding SVD and Principal Components
text: When you perform Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on a matrix, you decompose it into three matrices: U, Σ, and $$V^T$$. The principal component matrix P is related to these matrices. Think about how the principal components are derived from these components.

title: Role of U in SVD
text: The matrix U in SVD represents the left singular vectors of the original matrix. Consider how these vectors relate to the principal components. Are they directly the principal components, or do they need to be transformed?

title: Matrix Multiplication in SVD
text: To find the principal component matrix P, consider the role of Σ in the decomposition. Which matrix multiplication involving U and Σ gives you P?
